# v0.2.2 — Reliable PV charging and HA 2026.11 beta compatibility

This maintenance release fixes PV charging automations and prepares the
integration for the Home Assistant Marketplace. The minimum remains
**Home Assistant 2026.9.0**. Existing **0.2.x** entries, devices and entity IDs
can be kept.

## Action required for existing PV automations

After updating, open each **Charge from PV surplus** automation and select
the wallbox's new **Charging paused** input. Save the automation and reload
automations after the updated blueprint files are installed. **Until this
input is selected, the automation loads but sends no current commands.**

The integration updates unchanged bundled blueprints on setup and preserves
edited copies. Apply the changes to custom copies manually. Review any saved
pause/resume hold times: use more than five minutes; the new default is six
minutes. See the
[blueprint update instructions](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.2.2/docs/blueprints.md#updating-existing-blueprint-automations).

## Charging and reliability fixes

- PV current control respects charging pauses, accepts W or kW, rejects invalid
  inputs and observes the configured current cap.
- Current is recalculated after resume, vehicle connection and phase changes,
  even when the power budget stays constant. An unknown initial setpoint in
  unlimited mode can now receive its first PV current limit.
- Phase-switch rate limits report the remaining wait as a translated Home
  Assistant error. The existing current-write and pause/resume intervals remain.
- Reconfiguration avoids duplicate reloads, addressing the announced HA
  2026.12 restriction. Failed/cancelled serial probes close their transports,
  and removing an entry clears only its own repair issues.

## Home Assistant and installation

- Validated with **HA 2026.9.0 and 2026.10.0**, plus **2026.11.0b1** as a beta
  compatibility target. This does not claim validation of November stable or
  HA 2026.12; compatibility will be checked again when stable is available.
- The catalog and setup display name is now **Mennekes Amtron RTU**. The domain
  remains `mennekes_amtron_rtu`.
- The README provides a direct Marketplace repository button. Marketplace
  installation, update and rollback are tested with the real November
  installer and local download fixtures. HACS remains supported on HA 2026.9/10.

## Recorder and maintenance

The [Recorder guide](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.2.2/docs/recorder.md)
explains history retention and optional profiles retaining 17, 7 or 2 statistics
series. The existing 30-second measurement default remains. These profiles
require a user configuration change; the integration does not delete data or
change global Recorder settings, and history purges do not remove long-term
statistics.

Routine dependency updates are now grouped quarterly, with security updates
handled separately. Installation and daily-use documentation have been revised.

Automated validation uses real Home Assistant, SQLite and simulated Modbus RTU
devices. Physical-wallbox validation is still outstanding. Upgrading from
**0.1.0** requires the separate
[domain migration](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.2.2/docs/upgrading.md).

One installation archive serves HACS and the Marketplace:
**`ha-mennekes-amtron.zip`**. Checksums, build metadata and an SPDX SBOM
accompany the package.
